findings.name: Inline event handler in the markup
findings.why: Inline handlers are how a generated prototype wires the first interaction it can think of. They bypass the component boundary, the state model and the focus behaviour.
findings.fix: Bind the interaction in the component or module that owns the state, not in the tag.

findings.name: Glowing accents on a dark page
findings.why: Neon borders on every card turn a dark interface into a wall of light where nothing stands out.
findings.fix: Keep the dark theme, drop the glow. One accent, no bloom.

findings.name: Repeating-gradient stripes
findings.why: Stripes fill space with visual noise and are the cheapest way to make an empty area look designed.
findings.fix: A plain surface, or a texture that belongs to the design (paper, halftone, scan lines) at a size you chose on purpose.

score.hint: remove the decoration that is not a physical property of the interface
